{{Top|leg}}
A '''Derilyn Travel Waiver''' was a type of permit that was issued by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] to civilian [[Starship/Legends|starships]], to grant them permission to travel through [[Imperial Interdicted Space]] in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]], to reach the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Derilyn]].
